entities.summary: Malcolm John Charles Harbour, CBE, is a British Conservative Party politician who was a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the West Midlands between 1999 and July 2014. He was a member of the European Conservatives and Reformists Group and the chairman of the Committee on Internal Market and Consumer Protection.
